ops.title: claude .storage-write.lock / .oauth_refresh.lock must be per-account (overlay carve-out)
ops.body:
## Symptom
`claude /login` (or `claude auth login`) for a pool account completes OAuth ("Login successful") but then hangs ~15s and the account is "Not logged in"; no credential lands in the Keychain (`Claude Code-credentials-<hash>`) or anywhere ccp reads. Every relogin fails identically, on symlink AND fileprovider overlays. Plausibly also the trigger for fleet-wide session 401s: live sessions can't SAVE refreshed tokens, so they expire and 401 en masse.

## Root cause
claude 2.1.204 guards its atomic OAuth-token save with a **mkdir/rmdir lock DIRECTORY** at `<CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR>/.storage-write.lock` (and `.oauth_refresh.lock` for refresh). cc-pool's overlay carve-out classified these as *shared* (unlisted top-level entries default to a live symlink into `~/.claude` via `sharedTopLevel`). claude releases the lock with `rmdir(".storage-write.lock")`, and **`rmdir` on a symlink fails `ENOTDIR`** (POSIX never follows the final symlink component) → "Failed to save OAuth tokens" → nothing persisted. Confirmed in claude's own debug log (`claude --debug-file`): `ENOTDIR: not a directory, rmdir '.../.storage-write.lock'`.

`~/.claude/.storage-write.lock` became a real directory ~15:34 on 2026-07-07 (claude mkdir'd it through the shared symlink); from then every pool account's shared symlink pointed at it and every token save failed.

## Fix
Classify claude's lock dirs as private per-account in `internal/overlay/classify.go`: added `.storage-write.lock` / `.oauth_refresh.lock` to `PrivateEntry` (so `sharedTopLevel` returns false → never symlinked) and to `PrivatePrefixes` (routes them to the fuse/FP private root). MUST NOT go in `ExcludedEntries` — that pre-creates an empty dir, which makes claude's mkdir-to-acquire see EEXIST and hang. Tests: `TestPoolContentSourceClassify` + manifest carve-out `privateDirs` in `internal/overlay/contentsource_test.go`.

## Recovery for an already-broken account
The overlay re-creates the symlink on Sync, so a manual `rm` is only good for one login. Deploy the fixed binary + restart the daemon so Sync stops re-symlinking; then `rm <acctdir>/.storage-write.lock <acctdir>/.oauth_refresh.lock` and re-login. Diagnostics (safe, no secrets): `claude auth status` (per CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) shows loggedIn true/false; `claude --debug-file <path> auth login` captures the persist error.

## Red herrings ruled out first (do not re-chase)
Daemon token-rotation clobber race (failed with daemon dead); File Provider domain wedge (failed on plain symlink dir after `ccp fp repair --retreat`); Keychain ACL/partition-list from the v0.45.0 codesign change (keychain writes work; issue is a filesystem lock, not the keychain). macOS claude is Keychain-ONLY — no `.credentials.json` fallback exists to force.
ops.when: a pool account's claude /login reports success but leaves it 'Not logged in' / no credential persists; or investigating overlay entry classification (classify.go), token-save failures, or mass session 401s
